node.title: Minimum Sufficient Control Architecture (MSCA) — Canonical Architecture
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1.1 One MSCA instance is bound to one Objective Envelope · 2. Canonical kernel — S / E / C / P / M · 3. Representation is not sufficiency.

relations: MSCA could provide a later review structure for a bounded airport intervention: the protected outcome, justified control burden and authorized response must be explicit.
Transferencia retrospectiva propuesta; el caso histórico no documenta el uso de MSCA ni certifica seguridad del aeropuerto.
